people.name: Greece
people.line: A nation and culture, often in opposition to Israel

translations.web: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
translations.bsb: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.
translations.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
